# Performance Snapshot for Website Funnel

The dataset shows steady top-of-funnel growth, with a stronger lift in visits than in signups and paid customers. The most important story is that traffic is rising, but signup and paid conversion efficiency is only improving gradually.

## Best Chart Types and Monthly Funnel Trends

### Recommended visuals
- **Combo line chart** for Website Visits, Signups, and Paid Customers across months
- **Conversion rate line chart** for Signup Rate and Paid Conversion Rate
- **Funnel chart** for one selected month to show Visits → Signups → Paid Customers
- **Bar chart** for month-over-month growth in each metric

### Monthly conversion rates
| Month | Visits | Signups | Paid Customers | Signup Rate | Paid Conversion Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2026-01 | 12,000 | 840 | 96 | 7.00% | 0.80% |
| 2026-02 | 13,500 | 910 | 102 | 6.74% | 0.76% |
| 2026-03 | 12,800 | 880 | 110 | 6.88% | 0.86% |
| 2026-04 | 15,000 | 1,020 | 118 | 6.80% | 0.79% |
| 2026-05 | 16,200 | 1,105 | 123 | 6.82% | 0.76% |

### What the trends say
- **Website visits increased 35.0%** from January to May, the strongest growth in the dataset.
- **Signups increased 31.5%** over the same period, slightly below traffic growth.
- **Paid customers increased 28.1%**, which suggests the lower funnel is not scaling quite as fast as acquisition.
- **Signup rate stayed fairly stable** around 6.7% to 7.0%, so traffic quality is consistent.
- **Paid conversion rate is low and flat** at roughly 0.76% to 0.86%, which indicates the biggest improvement opportunity is after signup.

## Manager Takeaways and Dashboard Widgets

### Key insights for management
- Traffic growth is healthy, but **monetization is not keeping pace** with visits.
- The **best paid conversion month was March** at 0.86%, even though it was not the highest-traffic month.
- **May delivered the most visits and signups**, but paid conversion softened to 0.76%, suggesting a funnel bottleneck or lower lead quality.
- Because signup rate is stable, the main lever is likely **improving signup-to-paid conversion** rather than only buying more traffic.

### 3 most useful dashboard widgets
- **Funnel KPI card**: Visits, Signups, Paid Customers, plus current signup and paid conversion rates
- **Trend sparkline panel**: 5-month lines for all three metrics with month-over-month deltas
- **Conversion health widget**: Signup rate vs paid conversion rate, with alerting when paid conversion drops below target
